$comment: Everything template code may import. Mirrors the platform's TEMPLATE_REPO_DEP_ALLOWLIST — the set of packages a Mosaic host resolves for external repos. Enforced by tools/check-deps.mjs (pure Node, no install needed). Per-file exceptions carry a reason.

exceptions.reason: Build-time generator, not template code — reads preview assets and writes template-manifest.json.
Starter media: the existence probe for the bundled starter pack (a missing file degrades to the template's own stand-in, never an error mosaic) — the same probe template-utils' starterMedia runs.
